name: Final Drop 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Final Drop is a fast-paced battle royale shooter where up to 100 players battle across a vibrant island packed with weapons, resources, and room to build. Loot gear, throw up walls, floors, and ramps in the heat of combat, and outplay your rivals in a nonstop fight for survival.
